_comment: Selection of rules that become .claude/rules files in the service template. Only review/manual/runtime rules may be listed: anything tagged ci, lint or test already fails the build. `notes` are template-specific hints that do not come from rules.yml.

files.name: security
files.title: Security and secrets (always loaded)
notes: Deny rules in `.claude/settings.json` are guardrails, not a security boundary (AGT-020).

files.name: api-contracts
files.title: HTTP API code
notes: Change `docs/api/openapi.yaml` first with `scripts/export_openapi.py`; the contract test fails on drift (API-001, API-002).
The liveness and readiness probes are the declared unauthenticated exception (docs/FINDINGS.md F-08).

files.name: domain-code
files.title: Domain and application code
notes: Money is integer cents, never floats; add Hypothesis property tests for invariants (TST-020).

files.name: observability
files.title: Logging and telemetry
notes: Tracing export is not set up in this template; do not initialise an OpenTelemetry distro without the ADR.
